scope: Atom.Status, Atom.Updated At, Projection.Updated At and Journal; read-only, actual live Drafts

Atom.Status.why_not_zero_prose: Archive must preserve prior Version and Updated At, and create no new Version; a current Archived value is not an observed archive transition.

Atom.Updated At.why_not_zero_prose: The actual accepted edit time, no-op and archived predecessor require the correct event and state pair.

Journal.why_not_zero_prose: Append-only ordered history, record identity and content preservation, correction provenance, and authority are stronger than static containment.

Projection.Updated At.why_not_zero_prose: The most recent completed rebuild requires an ordered, complete set of applicable rebuild results and an authenticated completion time.

shared_candidate.name: generic observation-pair context for state-preservation invariants
shared_candidate.suggested_shape: An evaluated transition has one source-bound logical bearer, a before-state and an after-state; a CFEL equality may compare the same declared Property in those two states. Exact surface syntax is deliberately not selected.
two_genuine_uses: For the observed archive transition, compare Atom.Version and Atom.Updated At before and after; separately ensure the transition does not create a new Version.
For an observed exact no-op, compare Atom.Updated At before and after.
candidate_semantics: Evaluation observes already-established transition evidence; it does not cause or schedule a change.
Bind both snapshots to the same logical bearer through authoritative lineage, never by assuming a mutable ID proves identity.
Retain event-specific applicability and evaluate a complete set of required observations; an unresolved event class, missing predecessor, missing value or incomplete history must not count as pass.
Compare values under their declared Format without implicit normalization. An archive may be carrier/status movement and must not be mistaken for an accepted edit.
This state-pair facility does not itself implement the Operations, assign event times, generate transitions or establish ordering of event histories.
shared_candidate.not_a_claim: This is a typed semantic direction for at least two real uses, not an admitted CFEL grammar, an accepted independent predicate or an executable exact rewrite.

remaining_not_solved_by_pair: Actual Project-time at an accepted edit requires source-bound event completion time, timezone and actual-result identity, not merely equality of two states.
Projection Updated At requires complete ordered completed rebuild observations and an unambiguous latest result; an archive/no-op pair does not define latest.

Journal no deletion/reorder and append-only correction requires identity-preserving ordered collection comparisons and correction provenance, plus authority; scalar before/after equality alone does not express them.
Journal logical Artifact and Projection view meaning cannot be reduced to transition comparisons without separately admitted semantic relations.
counterexamples: Using IMMUTABLE(Atom.Updated At) after first Current would forbid a legitimate later accepted edit that changes its timestamp.

DETERMINES over equal ID/Version can constrain duplicate states but cannot prove which event was an exact no-op, establish an archive did not create a Version, or bind the recorded time to a real edit.
Two Journal snapshots may contain the same number of records while an accepted record is replaced or reordered.
An otherwise valid timestamp can point to an older rebuild or a failed later rebuild.

one_blocking_decision.question: Should CFEL evaluation receive source-bound, complete transition/event observations with same-bearer before/after states as explicit evaluation context, so reusable state-pair invariants can refer to them without declaring new authored fields?
one_blocking_decision.option_a: Yes: specify admitted event categories and their Operations-supplied, auditable bindings before designing surface syntax; retain all current prose until verified equivalent.
one_blocking_decision.option_b: No: retain these history requirements as prose until independently governed Operations contracts can own and validate them; do not claim zero-prose coverage.
one_blocking_decision.why_this_is_discriminating: Without a shared, trustworthy observation and lineage binding, apparent equality syntax cannot tell an archive, no-op, accepted edit or completed rebuild from any other pair of states. This decision does not itself resolve Journal authority, latest selection, or syntax.

limits: No Draft edits, invented event types or workflow execution. Exact current Claims retained until supported full equivalence; Primary Semantics unchanged.
